lines: Tardigrades, also known as water bears or moss piglets, are a phylum of eight-legged segmented micro-animals.
They were first described by the German zoologist Johann August Ephraim Goeze in 1773, who called them Kleiner
In 1776, the Italian biologist Lazzaro Spallanzani named them Tardigrada, which means "slow walkers".

lines: A coral reef is an underwater ecosystem characterized by reef-building corals.
Reefs are formed of colonies of coral polyps held together by calcium carbonate.
Most coral reefs are built from stony corals, whose polyps cluster in groups.

lines: A glacier is a persistent body of natural ice, a form of rock, that is constantly moving under its own weight.
A glacier forms where the accumulation of snow exceeds its ablation over many years, often centuries.
It slowly flows and deforms under stresses induced by gravity, undergoing both ductile and brittle deformation
